purpose: Predetermined price, market, portfolio and observable-event experiments; no revenue universe required
universe: Dynamic historical TWSE and TPEx four-digit regular stock rows (including four-digit TDRs, foreign and innovation-board shares); excludes ETFs, warrants and emerging-market stocks; no current listing or popularity screen
entry: Next session open after signal close
exit: 20th holding session close; stay cash until next entry open
baseline: Each signal date: positive raw OHLC and volume >=100000 shares (100 lots), 61-session indicator history; rank forward-adjusted 20-session return, equal-weight top10. No price/turnover/top60 restriction.

strategies.rule: Signal volume >1.5x prior20-session mean volume, and signal close >=previous close
20-session log-return volatility <= median among contemporaneously eligible stocks
>50% of all contemporaneously observed ordinary shares with features above MA20; require >=500 observations; otherwise cash
Top10 inverse 20-session volatility weights, cap20% per name, unallocatable capital cash
Only signal dates in final15+ calendar days of Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec; other cohorts cash
Observed reference-price corporate adjustment on signal day or within previous5 sessions; not assumed cash-only or pre-announced
Exclude observed reference-price corporate adjustment within previous5 sessions
Same baseline ranking, but signal-date volume >=50000 shares (50 lots)

priceAdjustment: Forward reference-price factor from official TWSE/TPEx effective-date references and FinMind face-value changes; numeric signed close change only on ordinary comparison days. Prior TPEx nextReference is not a substitute for an official event reference. This is a reference reinvestment proxy, not audited cash dividends. Unknown references start a new price segment, cannot be crossed by return calculation, and require61-session warmup again.
benchmark: Official TAIEX total-return index; entry open derived from same-date TR/price index scale
knownLimits: 50/100 lots is only a basic tradability gate; opening liquidity, capital capacity and slippage remain distinct
No optimizing thresholds or selecting winners on the validation period
Events use only effective events already observed, not hindsight future event calendar
Historical date-only events do not establish earlier announcement timestamps
Unresolved missing execution data suppresses deployable portfolio metrics
61-session warmup is needed for these indicators; no pre-IPO history is invented
sensitivity: Separate execution-cost scenario adds 0.5% adverse entry and 0.5% adverse exit prices; no thresholds retuned
inference: Primary outcomes: paired net return difference and paired probability of beating same-window TAIEX TR. Three-cohort circular block bootstrap, 10000 draws; family correction across16 rules x2 outcomes=32 comparisons. Win rates are portfolio-cohort rates, not individual-stock trade rates.
